defective_pattern: Using indiscriminate cell.replace('*', '') to remove markdown formatting, which strips trailing statistical significance stars (*, **, ***), and filling sparse matrix cells (like upper diagonals) with hyphens instead of leaving them blank.
why_defective: Corrupts statistical data in tables by erasing significance levels and violates APA table design principles by introducing visual clutter.
observed_symptoms: Significance asterisks stripped from table cells
Upper diagonal cells filled with hyphens instead of blank
corrective_remedy: Distinguish markdown bolding from statistical asterisks; leave empty matrix cells strictly blank without hyphens.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Flag tables where correlation matrix upper diagonals contain hyphens or asterisks are absent from p < .05 cells.
